message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.sold_out: Nothing left for sale today. Come back tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.gone: That horse has already been sold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.bought: The %1$s is yours (%2$s emeralds). Treat it well and it will learn to trust you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.too_poor: %1$s shakes their head: the stable can't find %2$s emeralds for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.sold: You sold %1$s to the stable for %2$s emeralds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.destrier_l: The knight's %s breaks loose, still in its war tack. Earn its trust and it's yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.pony_loose: The raider's %s bolts free. Break it in and it's yours.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.title: %s, stablehand of %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.title: %s, farrier of %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.subtitle: Boarding %s emeralds a week · Your purse: %s emeralds
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.subtitle: Shoeing %s emeralds · Your purse: %s emeralds
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.yours_none: None of your horses are nearby.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.kept_none: You have no horses boarded here.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.locked.prospe: Only a prosperous kingdom stocks this
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.locked.wealth: Only a wealthy kingdom stocks this
message.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.greet: %1$s, farrier of %2$s: "Shoes, tack, whatever your horse needs."
message.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.none_near: There's no farrier near enough to talk to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.shod: %1$s fits %2$s with new shoes and trims its hooves (%3$s emeralds).
message.jaymoskingdoms.caravan.bags_empt: These saddlebags have already been emptied.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stable.break_in.tex: The stable at %1$s is short of horses, and the ones we buy cost the earth. Catch a wild one, break it in yourself, and bring it to me. Not one you bought, mind: I'll know.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stable.stud.title: A Fine %s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stable.stud.text: I want to breed better %1$s. Bring me one of your own that's good enough for it: %2$s%% quality or better. You'll be paid what it's worth and more.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.break_in.title: A Horse for the King
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.break_in.text: My stables at %1$s are full of horses bred to the saddle. I want one with the wild still in it, that nobody but you has ridden. Catch one, break it in, and bring it to me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.race.title: The Ride to %s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.race.text: My stablemaster swears no horse in the realm can reach %1$s in under %2$s seconds. Prove him wrong: ride there (%3$s, %4$s) before your time is up, then come back and tell me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stablehand.wheat.te: The horses eat more than the whole town. Bring me %1$s %2$s before the stalls go hungry.
Nothing settles a nervous horse like a carrot. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stablehand.wolves.t: Wolves have been circling the paddock at night and the horses won't settle. Kill %1$s of them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.iron.title: Iron for Shoes
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.iron.text: Every horse in town needs shoes and I've run out of iron. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.coal.title: Coal for the Forge
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.coal.text: My forge is going cold. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.leather.tex: Bridles and saddles don't stitch themselves. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.break_in: Break in a wild horse and bring it to %s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.stud: Bring %3$s a %1$s of %2$s%% quality or better.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.race.won: You rode into %s with %s seconds to spare! Go back and tell the king.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.race.lost: Time's up: you didn't reach %s in time. The race is lost.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.offer: %s will take you to (click one; you pay in emeralds):
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.busy: %s is busy just now. Try again when the rickshaw's back at its rank.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.nowhere: There's nowhere near enough for %s to take you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.too_far: Stand by the rickshaw to hire it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.cant_pay: The fare is %s emeralds, and you don't have them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.off: %s takes you to %s for %s emeralds. Sneak to get down on the way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.take_the: %s carries goods and townsfolk. %s keeps a carriage for travellers: it waits across the bell.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.worn_out: %s looks worn out. It'll be a slow ride.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cab.off: %s drives you to %s for %s emeralds. Sneak to get down on the way.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.rabbits.text: Rabbits have been at my carrots every night this week. Thin them out for me: %1$s of them should do.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.zombies.text: The dead come up out of the dark and trample my rows flat. Put down %1$s %2$s before they ruin the harvest.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.bones.title: Bones for the Soil
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.bones.text: Nothing feeds a field like bone meal. Bring me %1$s %2$s and I'll grind them myself.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.seeds.title: Grandfather's Seed Pouch
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.seeds.text: My grandfather's seed pouch was lost when his camp was overrun, out at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. The seed in it came from the old country. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.beef.title: Beef for the Larder
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.beef.text: The larder's nearly bare and folk are asking. Bring me %1$s %2$s, fresh as you can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.pork.title: Pork for the Smokehouse
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.pork.text: I've a smokehouse with nothing in it. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.mutton.text: There's a feast coming and not enough mutton. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.chicken.tex: Bring me %1$s %2$s and there'll be stew for the whole street.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.rabbit.text: Rabbit pie is what they want and rabbit is what I lack. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.cleaver.tex: My master's cleaver was taken by bandits who camped at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Fetch the %1$s back; no blade has ever cut so clean.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.wolves.tex: Wolves have been circling the flock at dusk. Drive them off for good: %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.spiders.te: Spiders creep into the pasture and spook the sheep half to death. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.string.tex: The loom is hungry. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.shears.tex: The golden shears my family has kept for generations were lost at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Please, bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.leatherworker.leath: The tanning vats sit empty. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.leatherworker.hides: A lady wants a rabbit-fur cloak. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
Travellers pay well for a lucky charm. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.leatherworker.saddl: The finest saddle I ever stitched was left at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s when its rider fell. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.cod.title: A Catch of Cod
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.cod.text: The boats came back empty. Bring me %1$s %2$s for the market.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.salmon.te: The salmon are running and I'm laid up. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.ink.title: Ink from the Deep
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.ink.text: The scribes pay well for ink. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.drowned.t: Drowned things climb onto the jetty at night. Put %1$s %2$s back under the water.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.compass.t: My brother's ship went down at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. His %1$s is all I ask back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.feathers.t: I can't fletch arrows without feathers. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.flint.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the guards go through arrows like water.
Skeletons have been shooting at the woodcutters. Put down %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.bow.title: Grandsire's Bow
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.bow.text: My grandsire's bow was lost when he fought at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.iron.title: Iron for the Forge
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.iron.text: The forge is cold for want of iron. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.coal.title: Coal for the Forge
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.coal.text: No coal, no steel. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.pillagers.t: Pillagers have been robbing the roads. Kill %1$s %2$s and I'll see you plated for it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.helm.title: The Ancestral Helm
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.helm.text: My grandfather's helm was taken by raiders to the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Win back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.zombies: I need to know my blades bite. Slay %1$s %2$s and tell me how they held.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.pillage: Pillagers rob every cart that leaves. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.iron.te: Bring me %1$s %2$s and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.blade.t: The blade my master forged for the old king broke at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s so I can mend it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.toolsmith.iron.text: The miners keep breaking picks. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.toolsmith.coal.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the bellows are wheezing on nothing.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.toolsmith.pick.text: Old Hrolf dropped his pick fleeing the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s; it's the best I ever made.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.tome.text: A tome of great learning is said to lie in the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.paper.tex: The archive needs copying. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.ink.title: Ink for the Scribes
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.ink.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the scribes have run dry.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.undead.title: Lay the Dead to Rest
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.undead.text: The dead walk too close to the village. Lay %1$s %2$s to rest.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.eyes.title: Spider Eyes
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.flesh.title: Rotten Flesh
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.relic.title: The Holy Relic
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.relic.text: A holy relic was carried off to the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s before something worse finds it.
A chart of the coast went down with a ship at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cartographer.map.te: An old map of these lands was left at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cartographer.phanto: Phantoms dive at anyone travelling by night. Bring down %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.clay.title: Clay for Bricks
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.clay.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the kiln is waiting.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.quartz.title: Quartz for the Chapel
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.quartz.text: The chapel needs quartz. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.silverfish.te: Silverfish have got into the quarry stone. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.chisel.title: The Master's Chisel
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.chisel.text: My master's chisel lies at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s, where he carved his last. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.logs.title: Timber for the Works
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.logs.text: We're short of timber for the new houses. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.cobble.text: The walls won't build themselves. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.plans.title: The Lost Plans
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.plans.text: The plans for the new hall were lost at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.spiders.title: Spiders in the Tunnels
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.spiders.text: Cave spiders have nested in the tunnels. Clear out %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.creepers.text: Creepers keep wandering into the mine. Kill %1$s %2$s before they bring the roof down.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.torches.title: Light for the Mine
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.torches.text: The tunnels are black as pitch. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.lantern.title: The Lost Lantern
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.lantern.text: A lantern was left burning deep in the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Fetch the %1$s.
Spiders drop on us from the branches. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.saplings: For every tree we fell, two should grow. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.axe.text: My father's felling axe was left at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.monsters.text: Monsters prowl the roads at night. Slay %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.skeletons.tex: Skeletons have been shooting at the watch. Put down %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.pillagers.tex: Pillager patrols have been sighted. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.blade.title: A Comrade's Blade
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.blade.text: My comrade fell at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s so we can bury it with honour.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.berries.title: Sweet Berries
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.berries.text: I've a mind to bake. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.flowers.title: Flowers for a Sweetheart
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.flowers.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; I've someone to court.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.heirloom.title: The Family Heirloom
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.heirloom.text: Our family's heirloom was lost at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.near.title: A Letter for %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.near.text: Would you carry this letter to %1$s? They're here in %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.far.title: A Letter to %2$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.far.text: Would you carry this letter to %1$s? It's a long road: %2$s lies at %3$s, %4$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.chief.title: The Chief of %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.chief.text: The barbarians of %1$s raid my villages and laugh at my guards. Go to their camp at %2$s, %3$s and bring me word their chief is dead. Go well armed: he does not die easily, and his people will fight for him.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.hint.oath: Sworn to him when he dies: +%s%% emeralds
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.hint.round: Slain out on his round: +%s%% emeralds
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.cunning.oa: You broke your oath with the blow. His realm will not forget it, but the one who sent you will pay well.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.cunning.ro: He died among his own people, his bread still warm. The one who sent you will pay well.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.alms: You look tired, friend. Take this, and go well.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.alms.near: %s stops for you, close enough to touch.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.tyran: The king of %1$s laughed at my envoy. No one laughs at me. Kneel to him, swear him your sword, and he will let you near his throne at %2$s, %3$s. Then end him. An oath to a dead man binds no one.

The king of %1$s is loved, and that offends me. Each day he leaves his throne at %2$s, %3$s to hand out bread with few swords at his back. He stops for any stranger who looks hungry. Look hungry, and let his kindness kill him.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.warlo: I would rather take the crown of %1$s on the field, but its king hides behind his walls and will not come out to fight me. Swear yourself his man, get near his throne at %2$s, %3$s, and finish what he is too craven to face me for.

The king of %1$s will not meet me in the field; he is too busy feeding peasants. Each day he walks out from his throne at %2$s, %3$s with bread and few guards. If he will not fight me, let him die among his loaves.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.paran: The king of %1$s plots against me. His spies are everywhere; I hear them at night. Strike first. Swear to him, let him trust you as I never trust anyone, reach his throne at %2$s, %3$s, and kill him before he kills me.

The king of %1$s smiles and hands out bread, and everyone loves him. It is a mask: he plots my end, I am sure of it. Each day he walks out from his throne at %2$s, %3$s with hardly a guard. Kill him before he moves against me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.revel: The king of %1$s refused my feast and called my court a tavern. Drink to his health, swear to his crown, and get close to his throne at %2$s, %3$s. Then make him the last guest of a very short party.

The king of %1$s plays the saint and makes my feasts look like gluttony. Each day he leaves his throne at %2$s, %3$s with bread for the poor and few guards. Take his bread, then take his life. We will drink to it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warband.title: The Host Against %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warband.text: I do not send knives in the dark. I send armies. Take my soldiers and my spoils cart against %1$s, sack its seat at %2$s, %3$s, and bring the cart home. If we are not at war with them yet, we will be the moment you say yes.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.warband: Lead %1$s's war party to sack %2$s: once the war is on, stand at %1$s's seat and use /kingdom war join.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.warband.cannot: War on %s can't be declared now (a truce, an alliance, or the same side).
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warlord.title: The Warlord of %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warlord.text: The illager camp of %1$s grows bolder by the day. Go to %2$s, %3$s and slay its warlord. His axe has felled better than you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.warch: A warchief of the illagers has taken the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s and gathers raiders for a war on my realm. Slay %1$s before the war comes to us. My best knights did not come back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.tomb_: Something old has woken in the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s. My scouts call it %1$s. End it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.stalk: A thing of bone and moss haunts the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, and its arrows never miss. Hunt down %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.frost: Travellers freeze on the road by the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s. %1$s lairs there. Destroy it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.bone_: Deep in the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, %1$s raises an army of the dead. Go down and break it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.brute: A brute of the Nether came through the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s and has made it a fortress. Kill %1$s before more follow.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.beast: A beast the size of a barn has made its lair by the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, and it has eaten a village's herds. Kill %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.plagu: A knight who died in plate walks again at the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, and the sick follow him. Put %1$s in the ground for good.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.letter.delivered: Letter delivered. Go back to %s for your pay.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.dig: Brush %s out of the suspicious gravel in the %s at %s, %s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none: They have no work to give.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.gone: %s has moved on. Find them and talk again.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.nothing: Nothing for you today. Come back tomorrow.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.nothing.king: The king has no task for you today.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.refuse: Begone. I've nothing for the likes of you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.king: You dare show your face here?
quest.jaymoskingdoms.untrusted: %s wants nothing to do with you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.untrusted.king: The king of %s will not trust you with his work until your name is better here.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.full: You carry %s quests already. Finish or give one up first.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.full.royal: You already carry out a king's decree. Finish it first.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cache_near: %s is somewhere close by, in the ruin.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.dig_near: %s lies buried here, in the suspicious gravel nearest the ruin's heart. Dig down and brush it out.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.accept: Thank you! I knew I could count on you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.accept.king: Go, and do not fail me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.thanks: Thank you, truly. Here, this is yours.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.thanks.king: The realm is in your debt. Take these, with my thanks.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.letter: A letter? For me? Thank you, friend.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.name: %s %s
relic.jaymoskingdoms.royal_gift: Given by %s, for service to the crown
relic.jaymoskingdoms.bloodthirst.desc: Heals you for a fifth of the damage you deal.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.frostbite.desc: Chills and slows whatever it strikes.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.stormcaller.desc: Now and then calls lightning down on its target.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.executioner.desc: Strikes harder at foes near death.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.second_wind.desc: When you're badly hurt, you heal quickly for a while (once a minute).
relic.jaymoskingdoms.retribution.desc: Sends back a quarter of the blows you take.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.bulwark.desc: Blows sometimes shield you with extra hearts.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.fleetfoot.desc: You move faster while you wear it.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.flameward.desc: Fire can't hurt you once you're burning.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_village.cl: The goblin king of %s has fallen to %s! The goblins scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_village.th: Word of the goblin king's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.welcome: The goblins of %s take you for one of their own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.exposed: The goblins of %s see through your disguise!
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.cry.murder: Murder! It's a big'un in a mask!
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.mutter.0: You're a tall one, ain't ya...
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.mutter.3: Back off from the boss, you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horse_throws: Your mount panics and throws you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.scroll_no_target: Nothing in sight to read it at.
message.jaymoskingdoms.caster_none: No kingdom or camp within 400 blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec.not: %s has nothing of yours to unmake: you've learned no perks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wizard_none: Stand by a grown villager to make them the court wizard.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/1: I wasn't born here, you know. My family came all the way from %2$s.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/2: Folk here still call me the stranger. I grew up in %2$s, a long way from this place.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/3: Some nights I miss %2$s. It's a long road back.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/4: My grandmother crossed half the world from %2$s to settle here. I've never seen it myself.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/5: Back in %2$s we did things differently, %1$s. I'm still getting used to this place.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/1: We moved here from %2$s, just over the hills. Not so different, really.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/2: I grew up in %2$s, not far from here. I still visit my kin when I can.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/3: My folks are in %2$s, a few days' walk away. They think I'm mad for living here.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/4: Came over from %2$s a few winters back. The weather took some getting used to.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_scho: I raised this rock to study the stars without the smoke of the towns, %1$s. The spell to bring it down again... I'm still working on that part.
Twelve years of notes, all up here. If the island ever comes down, the books come down with it, so I stay.
The clouds pass right through the garden some mornings. Wonderful for my research, terrible for my laundry.
I came up for one night of stargazing. That was, oh, a good few winters ago now.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_retr: Kings kept asking me to curse their neighbours. Up here nobody asks me anything, %1$s. Present company excepted.
I served three courts before I'd had enough of them. The wind is better company than any king.
A mage needs quiet to think. There's nothing quieter than a rock floating in the sky.
If any kingdom sent you to fetch me back, tell them you couldn't find the way up.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_ward: The island stays up because I keep it up, %1$s. Each morning I renew the spell. Miss a day and down it goes.
My master held this island before me, and her master before her. One day someone will hold it after me.
There's a village under us. I'd rather they never found out what keeps this rock off their roofs.
I can't leave for long. The spell holding us up gets thin when I'm not here.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_exil: I was a court wizard once, %1$s. One spell went wrong in front of the king, and they sent me as far from the ground as they could.
The crown said never to set foot in the realm again. They never said anything about floating above it.
I still keep the robe. They took the title, but they couldn't take what I know.
Some nights I can see the castle lights from here. I don't miss the place. Mostly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.0: A visitor! I raised this island to watch the stars, and I've not managed to bring it down since. Here, for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.1: Mind the edge. I'm a scholar, stuck up here by my own spell. Take a scroll for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.2: Oh! Nobody comes up here. I study the sky, and the sky is very close. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.0: You found my retreat. I left the courts for some peace up here. Take this, and don't tell the kings.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.1: A guest, at this height? I came up here to get away from kingdoms. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.2: Quiet up here, isn't it? That's why I stay. Here, something for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.0: Careful where you step. I'm the warden of this island; my spell keeps it in the sky. Take this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.1: Welcome, traveller. Without me this rock would fall. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.2: You climbed all this way? Then you've earned this. I keep the island up; you keep your footing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.0: I was a court wizard, once. Banished up here. It's good to see a face. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.1: The king sent me as far from the ground as he could. You found me anyway. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.2: An exile's hospitality isn't much, but take this. I've plenty of time to write them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant: Stop. By the king's command, every stranger's pack is searched. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.noble: Pardon the trouble, traveller. There's been thieving, and we're asked to look in strangers' packs. Would you mind?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.warlord: You. Pack open. The commander wants to know what strangers carry into his city.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid: Hold still. The king believes someone means him harm. Let's see what's in your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reveler: Ho there! Spot check, friend. What've you got in the pack? Anything for the feast?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.plain: Mind if I look in your pack? There's been things going missing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.more: Open it, or we open you. Those are the king's words, not mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.noble.more: We'll be quick, and anything that's yours stays yours. It's only that goods have gone missing from the stores.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.warlord.more: Steel, powder, poison. A soldier knows what to look for. Show me and you can go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.more: Knives, poison, letters to his enemies. You'd be amazed what we find. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reveler.more: Honestly it's mostly to see if anyone's brought cake. Go on, let's have a look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.plain.more: Just a look, then you're on your way. Folk have lost things lately.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant: Halt. Strangers pay the king's toll to walk his streets. %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.noble: Good day. There's a small toll for the upkeep of the roads, %s emerald, if you can spare it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.warlord: City toll: %s emeralds. It pays for the walls you're standing behind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid: Toll. %s emeralds. And your name, and where you've come from.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler: A coin for the king's feast! %s emerald, and you're welcome at the table.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.plain: There's a toll for using our road. %s emerald.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant.more: %s emeralds, into the king's coffers. Strangers who don't pay don't walk free.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.noble.more: %s emerald for the roads and the bridges. Nobody's turned away for being poor, mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.warlord.more: %s emeralds for the garrison. Walls don't build themselves, and soldiers don't eat stone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid.more: %s emeralds. Everyone pays. Everyone is written down. That's how we keep him safe.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler.more: %s emerald, and there's cake and ale for everyone tonight. The king insists!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.plain.more: %s emerald to keep the road mended. It's the same for everyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.tyrant: You look soft. %s emeralds says I put you on the ground. Or are you a coward as well?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.noble: Would you care for a friendly bout? %s emeralds on it, all in good sport.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.warlord: You carry yourself like a fighter. A bout, %s emeralds to the winner. Let's see what you've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.paranoid: You. Show me how you fight. %s emeralds on it. I want to know what you're capable of.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reveler: A wrestle! Best of one! %s emeralds, and the loser buys the next round!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.plain: Fancy a bout? %s emeralds says I'll have you on your back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.tyrant.more: Hands and feet, no blades. If you win, I'll be surprised. Put up %s emeralds or walk on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.noble.more: Bare hands, first to yield. %s emeralds each, and no hard feelings, whoever wins.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.warlord.more: Bare hands, first one down loses. %s emeralds. Better armour helps, so does a strong arm.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.paranoid.more: A bout, %s emeralds. If you're an assassin, I'd rather find out now than later.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reveler.more: No weapons, just a friendly scrap! %s emeralds! Everyone's watching, come on!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.plain.more: No weapons. %s emeralds. Armour and a strong arm will help you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.tyrant: Tell me, stranger. What do you think of our glorious king?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.noble: A question, if I may: how do you find our king? Folk say he's fair.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.warlord: What do you make of our commander? Speak freely, soldier to soldier.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.paranoid: What do you think of the king? Choose your words carefully.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reveler: Isn't our king the best? Go on, say it! Best king in the world!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.plain: What do you make of our elder?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.tyrant.more: Folk who speak well of him prosper. Folk who don't... don't. So?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.noble.more: We like to know what travellers think. It helps him rule well. Be honest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.warlord.more: Every man here would die for him. I want to know if you'd stand beside us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.paranoid.mor: There are people who'd see him dead. I'm only asking who you are. What do you think of him?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reveler.more: Nobody throws a feast like him. Nobody! Go on, what do you think?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.plain.more: Folk around here look up to them. Just curious what an outsider thinks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.guard.arrest: You defied the guards of %s. They'll take you by force for the next %s seconds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.t: What's this? Stolen! %s emeralds for the king, and pray he doesn't hear of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.n: Ah. I believe this belongs to the stores. A fine of %s emeralds, and we'll say no more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.w: Thief. %s emeralds to the garrison. Next time it's a cell.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.p: I knew it. Stolen goods. %s emeralds, and you're being watched from now on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.r: Oh dear, that's from the larder! %s emeralds for the feast and we'll forget it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.p: That's ours. %s emeralds, and don't do it again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.t: Nothing. Pity. An emerald for my trouble, then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.n: All in order. Thank you for your patience, and welcome.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.p: Nothing... this time. Off you go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.r: Not even a biscuit? Shame! Off you go, enjoy the feast.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.p: Nothing there. Sorry to bother you.
Refusing the king's men? Seize them!
As you wish. I can't make you. But I'll remember your face.
Hiding something, are we? I'll be watching you.
Only the guilty hide. Take them!
Suit yourself. But folk will talk.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.t: ...I see nothing here. Move along, quickly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.n: A bribe? You insult me, and you insult the king.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.w: Put that away before I cut your hand off. A soldier can't be bought.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.p: A bribe! Only someone with something to hide offers a bribe. Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.r: Ha! That'll buy a round. I saw nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.tyra: Into the king's coffers. You may pass.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.para: Paid. Your name's been noted. Go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.reve: To the feast! Here, have something sweet for your trouble!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.w: Hmph. %s, and you owe me a drink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.p: %s. Fine. But I've written it down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggled.r: Ha! You drive a hard bargain! %s it is!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggle_fa: Haggle? With the king's men? I'll take it all, and a slap for asking.
I'm afraid the toll is the toll. I'm sorry.
The toll's the toll, soldier. Pay it or don't.
Bargaining. Exactly what a spy would do.
No, no, full price! It's for the cake!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.ty: Then you'll pay in blood. Guards!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.no: Very well. The road is free to those who can't pay.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.wa: Cheapskate. Don't expect help from the garrison.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.refuse.pa: Refused. We'll be watching you very closely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.tyran: Ugh... Take your %s emeralds and get out of my sight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.noble: Well fought! Your %s emeralds, honestly won.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.warlo: Ha! Now that's a fighter! %s emeralds, and my respect.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.paran: Hm. Good. %s emeralds. I'll know to watch your left hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.won.revel: Ooh, my back! Brilliant! Here's your %s emeralds!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.tyra: Down in the dirt, where you belong. Your %s emeralds are mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.nobl: Good effort. I'll take the %s emeralds, but you fought well.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.warl: Not bad. Not good enough. %s emeralds. Come back when you've trained.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.para: Weak. Good. %s emeralds. You're no threat to anyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.reve: Hahaha! On your back! Thanks for the %s emeralds!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.lost.plai: Better luck next time. %s emeralds, please.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.decline.w: Afraid of a little scrap? Pathetic.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.decline.p: Not even to prove you're harmless? Interesting.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.ty: A dog, am I? Let's see you say it with a blade in your gut!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.no: That was uncalled for. Good day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.wa: Draw, then. You'll eat those words.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.pa: So that's what you are. Draw!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reply.insult.re: Ha! Grumpy! Have a drink, you need it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.praise: Good. Wise words keep heads on shoulders.
That's kind of you. He'll be pleased to hear it.
Ha! Well said! You'll fit in here.
Exactly! Here, a treat, for saying so!
Hm. That's what a flatterer would say. And an assassin.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.silent: Silence is an answer too. A poor one.
Fair enough. Actions matter more than words.
You'd rather not say. Why's that, I wonder?
Shy? Have some ale, you'll loosen up!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.ill.no: Hmph. Everyone's entitled to an opinion, I suppose.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.ill.wa: Say that again and I'll have your tongue. Get out of my sight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.ill.re: Ha! Grumpy! He'd laugh at that, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.pardon.prompt: You only half caught what %s said.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.0.more: Nothing you can't manage, I'd wager. Right-click me and I'll show you what needs doing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.1.more: Honest work, honest pay. Right-click me and see what I've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.2.more: I've asked everyone in the village and nobody will. Please, just right-click me and look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.0.more: The errand I gave you. Bring me what I asked and you'll be paid, as promised.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.1.more: You've still got the job I gave you. Check your journal (M) if you've forgotten.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.2.more: My errand, remember? If it's done, right-click me and we'll settle up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.0.more: Things went missing, and you were seen. Own up and pay a fine and we'll say no more of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.1.more: Something was taken, or broken, and folk say it was you. Pay up and it's forgotten. Lie and it's worse.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.2.more: You did a wrong here, stranger. Confess and pay and the matter's closed. Walk away and everyone will know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.0.more: We've had thieves and worse through %s. I'll only ask once: are you here to trade, to work, or something else?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.1.more: No offence meant. Every stranger in %s gets asked. Trade, work, or trouble?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.2.more: It's my job to know who walks the streets of %s. Tell me why you've come and you can go on your way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.0.more: Anything at all would do. Bread, a potato, whatever you can spare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.1.more: The stores ran low and my family comes first. Just one bite of something, if you have it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.2.more: I'm not begging, you understand. Well, I am. Any food you've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.0.more: %1$s %2$s, yours for %3$s emeralds. You'll pay more at any stall, I promise you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.1.more: I made too much, see, and it'll only go to waste. %1$s %2$s for %3$s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.2.more: Good work, fair price: %1$s %2$s for %3$s emeralds. Today only, mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.0.more: It's a thank-you, for being a good friend to us. Keep it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.1.more: I've had it for days, waiting for you to pass. It's in your pack now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.2.more: It's nothing, really, just something I thought you'd like. Check your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.0.more: %s marched on us, or we on them, it hardly matters now. Stand with us and we'll remember it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.1.more: The war with %s goes badly. Every blade helps. Say you'll stand with us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.0.more: Something about the taxes, I heard. Or his dinner. Either way, don't cross the castle folk today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.1.more: Little green things, she said, in masks, with a fort of sharpened logs. Ugh.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.2.more: The old ruins out in the wilds. Grim places. Folk come back changed, if they come back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.3.more: Leaned too close to the forge. Looks like a boiled egg now, poor lad.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.4.more: Painted faces and big axes. They take what they like and burn the rest. Travel in daylight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.5.more: The loaves are smaller and the price is the same. I've measured.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.6.more: Three mornings running, the coop's been empty. A fox wouldn't close the latch behind it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.7.more: Robed, with a staff, and the dead get up behind him. If you see one, run, or strike him first.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.8.more: Bandits, or the roads, or both. Whatever it is, bread costs more than it did.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.9.more: Past a portal of black stone and green eyes, they say. Sounds like a story to me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.more: That's all I heard, honest. Ask about the village if you want more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.you.stealth.m: It's what people say about %s, that's all. I'm only passing it on.
They talk about %s in the tavern every night. Big deeds make big stories.
Hunters swap stories about %s round the fire. You're half a legend out there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.0.more: We were only talking about you, %s. Stay a while, if you've time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.1.more: You've done right by us, %s. There's always a welcome here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.2.more: It's been too long, %s. Come and see us more often.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.0.more: Zombies, skeletons, worse. They come out once the sun's down. A bed and a door, that's what you want.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.1.more: Stay where the torches are. Whatever's out there doesn't like the light.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.2.more: Hissing in the dark, just past the fields. Keep your back to a wall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.0.more: Tag! You chase me and I run! You're it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.1.more: A knight! With a shiny helmet and everything! Are you? Are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.2.more: Your sword! I want to see it up close. Please please please?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.0.more: We don't get many travellers. I like to know where folk are going.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.1.more: You've got the boots of someone who walks a lot, and the scars too. Are you an adventurer?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.2.more: Our village. What do you think of it? Be honest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.3.more: Family. Somebody waiting for you somewhere. Have you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.4.more: You look like you've walked a long way. Have you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.5.more: My crops are drooping and I don't know why. Do you know anything about farming?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.6.more: I've a letter, see, and I never learned my letters. Can you read?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.7.more: Out there, on the road. What's the oddest thing you've ever seen?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.command.nobody: Nobody nearby could come over about that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.0: You there! You look like you can handle yourself. I could use a hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.1: Excuse me, traveller! I have work, if you want it, and I pay fair.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_offer.2: Oh, thank goodness, a capable face. Would you hear me out? I need help.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.0: Well? How goes the task I set you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.1: Any news on what I asked of you? Come, tell me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.quest_check.2: There you are! I was hoping to see you. Have you done it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.0: I know your face. Word is you were the one in our stores. Was it you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.1: Hold on. People are talking about you, and none of it good. Explain yourself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.2: You! Somebody saw what you did here. What have you to say for it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.answer.confes: It was me. I'll pay for it (%s emeralds)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.answer.deny: It wasn't me, I swear it
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.answer.threat: Keep talking and see what happens
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.confess: Honest, at least. Mind it doesn't happen again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.believe: Hm. Maybe I had the wrong of it. My apologies.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.liar: Liar. I'll be telling the others about you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.reply.threate: Help! Guards! This one's threatening me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.accuse.ignored: Walking away, are we? I knew it was you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.0: Halt, stranger. What's your business in %s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.1: You there, hold a moment. State your business in %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.2: Easy, traveller. Not many strangers come through %s. Why are you here?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.trade: Fair enough. Keep the peace and you'll have no trouble from me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.work: Work? Try %s, over that way. They were looking for help.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.no_work: Nobody's hiring that I know of. Ask about the village, someone may have something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.reply.rude: Watch your tongue, stranger. I'll have my eye on you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.halt.ignored: Hey! I'm talking to you! ...I'll remember that face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.0: Could you spare a bite to eat? The harvest's been thin this season.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.1: Sorry to trouble you, but I haven't eaten since yesterday. Have you any food?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.2: Spare a crust for a hungry neighbour? I'd be ever so grateful.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.reply.fed: Bless you! I won't forget this kindness.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.reply.refused: I understand. Times are hard for everyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.0: Fancy a bargain? I can let you have %s %s for %s emeralds. Better than the market!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.1: Psst, friend. I've %s %s going spare. Yours for %s emeralds?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.2: You look like someone who knows quality. %s %s, %s emeralds, today only.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bargain.reply.refuse: Your loss! Come find me if you change your mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.0: I made this for you. It's not much, but I wanted you to have it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.1: Here, I saved this for you. Don't say I never gave you anything!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gift.2: Oh, it's you! I was hoping I'd see you. Take this, please.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.0: They say we're at war with %s. Will you stand with us?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.1: Have you heard? It's war with %s. We need every arm we can get. Are you with us?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.reply.stand: Then the gods go with you, friend!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.war.reply.refuse: Then keep out of the way when the fighting comes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.0: Did you hear? The king's in a foul temper again. Best keep your head down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.1: My cousin swears she saw goblins in the woods past the river. Goblins!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.2: They say there's treasure in the old ruins, but nobody who goes looking comes back the same.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.3: Have you seen the smith's new apprentice? Burnt his eyebrows clean off yesterday.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.4: Barbarians were spotted on the road last week. Keep your blade close if you travel.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.5: The baker's been putting less flour in the bread. Don't tell him I said so.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.6: Somebody's been stealing eggs from the coop. If I find out who...
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.7: They say a necromancer raises the dead out past the hills. I don't go out after dark any more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.8: The caravans have been late all month. Prices are going up, mark my words.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.9: I hear there's a dragon at the end of the world. Not that I'd know where that is.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.0: %s! Good to see you again, friend!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.greet.2: Well, if it isn't %s! How have you been?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.0: It's getting dark, traveller. Get indoors before the dead start walking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.1: Night's falling. Don't wander far from the lights, the monsters are about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.warn.2: Stay close to the village tonight. I've heard the creepers out there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.0.yes: Ready or not, here I come!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.1: Whoa, is that real armour? Are you a knight?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.1.reply: I'm going to be a knight too when I grow up!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.2: Is that a real sword? Can I see it? Please?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.child.2.reply: Wooow. I bet you've slain a hundred monsters with that!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.0: Where are you headed, if you don't mind my asking?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.0.warm: Wherever the road takes me. This place looks nice, though.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.0.reply.war: A free spirit! Stay a while, you're welcome here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.0.reply.rud: Well! No need to be like that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.1: Are you an adventurer? You have the look of one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.1.warm: I am! Dungeons, monsters, the lot.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.1.reply.war: How exciting! You must tell me about it some day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.2: What do you make of our village?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.2.warm: It's lovely. You must be proud of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.2.reply.war: Thank you! We work hard to keep it so.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.2.reply.rud: Then go and live in one!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.3: Do you have any family out there?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.3.warm: I do, and I miss them. How about you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.3.reply.war: You're sweet to ask. My family's all I have.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.4: Have you come far? You look tired.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.4.warm: Very far. It's good to rest among friendly faces.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.4.reply.war: Then rest here as long as you need.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.4.reply.pla: Well, take care on the roads.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.4.reply.rud: Fine! I was only being kind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.5: Do you know anything about farming? My crops are wilting.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.5.warm: Try more water, and keep the chickens off them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.5.rude: Do I look like a farmer to you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.6: Can you read? I've a letter and I can't make it out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.6.warm: I can. I'd be glad to help sometime.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.6.reply.war: You're very kind. Not many would bother.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.7: What's the strangest thing you've seen on your travels?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.7.warm: A sheep that turned every colour of the rainbow!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.7.reply.war: Ha! Surely not! You're having me on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.question.7.reply.pla: Pity. I'd hoped for a story.
tack.jaymoskingdoms.wary: It won't show you its paces until it trusts you (trust %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.horse_comes: %s trusts you now: it will come when you whistle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.already_shod: Those shoes still have plenty of wear in them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.too_heavy: %s won't kneel for a rider in armour that heavy yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.brushed: You brush %s until its coat shines (trust %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.whistle_shy: Your horses don't trust you enough to come to a whistle yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whistle_none: No horse of yours hears the whistle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_slide_locke: A sliding stop needs racing level %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_needs_bridl: A sliding stop needs a bridle.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_kick_locked: The war kick needs war level %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trick_rear_locked: Rearing on command needs level %s in any discipline.
message.jaymoskingdoms.racing_throw: A bad landing pitches you out of the racing saddle!
message.jaymoskingdoms.lame: %s is going lame: pick its hooves or have it shod.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.orc: Drums in the hills! The orcs of %s march on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.orc_camp.cleared: The warchief of %s has fallen to %s! The orcs break and flee.
message.jaymoskingdoms.orc_camp.thanks: Word of the warchief's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.orc.rage_1: Blood! I smell my own blood!
journal.jaymoskingdoms.need: You need a Traveller's Journal in your inventory (craft a book with a map)
journal.jaymoskingdoms.no_places: No settlement knows your name yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.werewol: A howl, far too close, and then the snap of branches. Something on two legs is running on four.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.ogre: The ground shakes. Something huge is lumbering your way, and it has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.cave_og: Stones rattle down the slope. A grey shape the size of a hut is climbing toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.fire_og: A smell of brimstone on the wind, and a red glow coming over the rise.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.wraith: The air goes cold. Something pale is drifting toward you, through whatever is in its way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.flame_w: A flicker of flame where nothing burns, and it is coming closer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.silver_: A rattle of bones and the ring of steel. Pale shapes are running at you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.mud_gol: The mud heaves up and stands. It has your scent.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.werewol: They say a wolf the size of a man was seen %1$s blocks %2$s of here. On two legs, mind you.
Old Hob swears he saw something howling at the moon %1$s blocks %2$s. Something with hands. Only gold or silver will cut one, they say.
A stranger came through, nice as you like, then a beast tore through the sheep %1$s blocks %2$s that same night. I'm only saying.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.ogre.0: There's an ogre about, %1$s blocks %2$s. Flattened a cart and the ox with it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.ogre.1: Hunters came back white as milk. An ogre, %1$s blocks %2$s, they said, with two heads. Or they'd been drinking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.ogre.2: Don't go %2$s. There's an ogre %1$s blocks out, and it throws people when it hits the ground.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.cave_og: Miners won't go up the mountain now. A grey ogre, %1$s blocks %2$s, they say, bigger than the green ones.
Something grey and huge came down off the heights at night, %1$s blocks %2$s. A cave ogre, my gran says.
If you go %2$s, past %1$s blocks, keep off the high ground after dark. Cave ogre.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.fire_og: A fire ogre, %1$s blocks %2$s! Everything it hits goes up in flames.
Folk out in the red lands saw an ogre that burned like a forge, %1$s blocks %2$s of here.
My cousin's hat caught fire just from looking at it, he says. A fire ogre, %1$s blocks %2$s.
There's a wraith %1$s blocks %2$s. Walls don't stop them, you know. Nothing does.
Something pale was seen drifting over the fields %1$s blocks %2$s, through the hedges and the barn. A wraith.
Keep your lamp lit. A wraith was seen %1$s blocks %2$s, and the sun's the only thing that burns them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.flame_w: A wraith all on fire, %1$s blocks %2$s! Like a candle walking.
Travellers from the dry lands talk of a burning ghost, %1$s blocks %2$s of here.
A flame wraith, they're calling it. %1$s blocks %2$s. Don't let it touch you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.silver_: Silver skeletons, %1$s blocks %2$s. Two swords each, and they run.
A pack of skeletons with silver blades was seen %1$s blocks %2$s. Kill one and you might get a blade that cuts werewolves.
Don't go %2$s after dark, not past %1$s blocks. The skeletons there carry silver.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.beast.mud_gol: A mud golem crawled out of the bog %1$s blocks %2$s. Hit it all you like; the rain mends it.
The marsh %1$s blocks %2$s has a mud golem in it. It drags you down with every blow.
Fire's the thing for a mud golem, they say. There's one %1$s blocks %2$s, if you're brave.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.werewolf: A werewolf was seen near %s, %s. It walks among us by day, so kill it by night, and bring gold or silver: nothing else bites.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.ogre.tex: An ogre has been seen near %s, %s, smashing carts and herds. Put it down before it comes here.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.cave_ogr: A cave ogre comes down from the heights near %s, %s at night. Kill it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.fire_ogr: A fire ogre was seen near %s, %s. Everything it strikes catches fire. Kill it, and mind your hair.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.wraith.t: A wraith drifts near %s, %s, through walls and all. Lay it to rest.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.flame_wr: A burning wraith was seen near %s, %s. Put out its fire for good.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.silver_s: Silver skeletons were seen near %s, %s. Destroy one, and bring back its sword if it drops one.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.hunt.mud_gole: A mud golem has crawled out of the marsh near %s, %s. Kill it; fire bakes them brittle.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.werew: They say no one has lasted a night near %s, %s since the werewolf was seen there. Prove them wrong: be there after dark, and see the dawn.
Spend a night out near %s, %s, where the ogre was seen, and come back alive. Then folk might stop being afraid.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.cave_: Spend a night near %s, %s, where the cave ogres come down. Come back alive and I'll believe you're as tough as you look.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.fire_: Last a night near %s, %s, where the fire ogre was seen. Bring water.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.wrait: Wraiths have been seen near %s, %s. Spend a night there and see the sun come up.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.flame: Spend a night near %s, %s, where the flame wraith was seen, and live till dawn.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.silve: Survive a night near %s, %s, where the silver skeletons run.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast.survive.mud_g: Spend a night in the marsh near %s, %s, where the mud golem was seen, and come back alive.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.beast_near: %s has caught your scent. It's coming.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.survive_begun: Night falls, and %s comes for you. Last till dawn.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.survived: Dawn, and you're alive. Go back to %s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.survive_failed: You didn't last the night. Try another night.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.survive: Be near %2$s, %3$s at night, where the %1$s was seen, and last till dawn.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mythic_mount.nigh: Hoofbeats, and a smell of smoke. A horse made of night and embers is watching you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mythic_mount.bat_: Leathery wings beat in the dark. A horse is coming down out of the trees.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.hint: (The ruler ought to hear of this. Right-click him to warn him.)
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.rival.0: A stranger with a foreign accent was asking when %s walks out of an evening. Paid for his ale in foreign silver, too.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.rival.1: They say the rival court wants %s dead, and they've the gold to see it done.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.people.0: Folk have had enough of %s. I heard a hat went round the tavern... and it wasn't for a feast.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.people.1: Hush. Some of us clubbed together. A man in a hood is coming for %s. You didn't hear it from me.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.heir.0: The heir's grown tired of waiting for %s to die. Someone may help him along.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.heir.1: A hooded man met the heir by the well last night. Nobody speaks of it. Pray for %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.guild.0: There's a black candle in the tavern window. That's the guild's mark: someone's paid for %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.guild.1: A stranger was counting the guards' steps round the hall. I'd not want to be %s tonight.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.you.0: Psst, %s. A man in a hood was asking after you. Where you sleep, which way you walk.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.you.1: %s, someone's put a price on you. Keep your back to a wall after dark.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.you.2: I saw your name on a scrap of paper in a stranger's hand, %s. Then he burned it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.sense: You feel eyes on your back...
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.sense.rogue: Soft steps behind you. Someone of your own trade is following you.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.1: Fine evening. Mind your own business and it'll stay fine.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.2: Looking for someone. Not you. Not yet.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.stranger.known: You know that walk: this one's an assassin.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.strikes: An assassin throws off his cloak and stabs %s!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.poisoned: The blade was poisoned! %s is dying. Milk, honey or a golden apple may save him (right-click him with it).
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.parried: %s was warned: he turns the assassin's blade aside and calls his guards!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.parried.says: I knew you'd come! Guards! Seize him!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.purged.says: The physician's draught... I'll live. Find who sent him!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.stabbed: A blade in your side, and a burning in the wound: poison! An assassin!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.warned.says: A blade for me? I'll double the watch. You have my thanks.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.warned: You warn %s of the whispers. He'll be on his guard.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.cured.says: %s... you've saved my life. I won't forget it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.cured: %s gives the antidote to %s, and the poison is beaten.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.survived: Word spreads: %s of %s survived an assassin's blade.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.caught: The assassin sent for %s of %s lies dead.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.caught.by: The assassin sent for %s of %s was cut down by %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.exposed: The assassin's contract bore the seal of %s. %s won't forget it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.murdered.ki: %s of %s has been murdered by an assassin! His heir will be crowned on the morrow.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.murdered.lo: %s of %s has been murdered by an assassin! His heir takes the seat on the morrow.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.riva: In %s they say foreign gold paid for it, but no one can prove whose.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.peop: In %s nobody weeps much. They say his own people paid for it.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.heir: In %s they say the heir looks very little like a grieving son.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.news.rumour.guil: In %s a black candle burns in the tavern window. The guild has been paid.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.caught: The assassin is dead. His contract and his purse are yours.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.caught.hi: The assassin is dead. His contract bears the seal of %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.killed: An assassin's blade. Someone paid well for that.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.player.killed.hi: An assassin's blade, paid for by %s.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.command.sent: An assassin is on his way.
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.r: Sealed with a foreign crest, scratched out
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.p: Signed with a dozen crosses: his own people
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.h: Sealed with the heir's own ring
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.g: Marked with a black candle: the guild
Sealed with a crest, scratched out
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.r: Marked with a black candle: the guild settles its own
class.jaymoskingdoms.thief.desc: Light blades (daggers, knives, ninjato) hit 25% harder and swing faster. Leather, chain and hide give a point more armour a piece.
class.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.desc: Two-handed weapons (claymores, war axes, glaives, halberds) hit 25% harder. Heavy armour weighs half as much on you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.mage.desc: A wizard's staff casts in your hands, and you learn every scroll you read. Two hearts fewer. A court wizard will teach you how a staff is made, or find one. Pick your first spell.
class.jaymoskingdoms.archer.desc: Arrows and bolts hit 25% harder, and you're quicker on your feet. With a bow drawn you jump two blocks and land soft.
class.jaymoskingdoms.survivalist.desc: Hunger drains slower, you drown slower, falls hurt less, a heart more, and a little quicker on your feet.
class.jaymoskingdoms.brute.desc: Maces, flails and axes hit 30% harder; a raised shield stops what gets past other shields, and comes back sooner. Two hearts more. Slower, and heavy armour weighs twice as much on you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.marksman.desc: Guns hit 30% harder, reload and wind up 35% faster, fly half again as far and bend a little toward their mark. Light armour gives a point more a piece. A heart fewer.
class.jaymoskingdoms.sorcerer.desc: Imbue your blade with an element of your own: water, fire, earth, air, lightning or ice. One blow in twenty bursts with it. Fewer spells than a Mage, but quicker ones. Pick your element.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.fire.desc: Three bolts of fire in a fan.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.arcane.desc: A lance of light at what you're looking at, twice as hard on the undead.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.warding.desc: Absorption for you and the players beside you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.water.desc: Douses, slows, and hurts what fears water.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.ice.desc: Freezes what it hits for a moment.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.class.title: Choose your class
gui.jaymoskingdoms.class.lead: What are you good with? Your pick is for keeps, unless you come by a Writ of Rebirth. Nobody starts with gear: the cards show what each class is good with.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.reborn: The writ crumbles. What you were falls away; choose again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ: You've learned nothing I could unmake. But I have a Writ of Rebirth, if you'd be someone else entirely: %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ.sold: %s has no writ for you this week; the ink takes time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.writ.done: Read it when you're ready. There's no reading it twice.
command.jaymoskingdoms.class.cleared: %s player(s) have no class now; they'll be asked again.
class.jaymoskingdoms.rider.desc: Born to the saddle: your horse runs 15% faster and tires slower under you, horses come to trust you sooner, and you strike 20% harder from horseback. On foot you're a touch slower, bow-legged.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.draining.des: Life drawn from what you're looking at, into you.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.raising.desc: A zombie and a skeleton climb out of the ground to fight for you a while.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spell.learned: You learn %s. Sneak and use your staff to turn to it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spell.only: Your staff knows only %s. Read scrolls to learn more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.no_blade: Hold a blade to imbue it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.imbue.faded: The element fades from your blade.
message.jaymoskingdoms.scroll_beyond: This scroll is beyond a Sorcerer's quick magic.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.mage_staff: A wizard's staff casts in a Mage's hands. Sneak and speak to a court wizard to learn how one is made, or find one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.staff_recip: You learn how a wizard's staff is made: gold and amethyst on two blaze rods. It's in your recipe book.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.staff: A Mage without a staff? I can tell you how one is made. And I have a Writ of Rebirth, if you'd be someone else entirely: %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.staff.done: Gold and amethyst, bound to two rods of blaze. Mind your fingers.
message.jaymoskingdoms.alien.seen: The people of %s saw you change. They know the alien is you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.alien.seen: Saints preserve us... that thing is you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.0: Look! Look up! The sky's on fire!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.meteor.1: A falling rock... it's coming down this way!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.0: A shooting star! No, it's too big... it's falling!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.1: See it? A star, coming down to earth!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.star.2: Make a wish... and then run.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.0: Did you feel that? Something came down out there!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.1: It struck the ground! The whole earth shook!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.landed.2: Stay back from where it hit, I beg you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.child.2: Whoa... when I grow up I'm doing that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.0: Did... did you all see that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.1: That's no trick of the light. That's sorcery.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.2: I'm not drinking at the tavern tonight. I've seen enough.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.0: They called the wind like a dog to heel!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.1: The air itself is doing what they say!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.wind.2: Hold onto your hats... and your roofs.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.0: Ropes! Out of their wrists! Like a spider!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.1: They swing from the rooftops like it's nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.web.2: I'll be finding cobwebs on my washing for a week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.1: Things fall UP around that one. I saw it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.gravity.2: Don't stand near them, the ground goes heavy.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.1: I blinked and they were somewhere else entirely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.chrono.2: There were two of them for a moment. Two!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.0: Blades out of thin air! Out of nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.1: Where are all those weapons coming from?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.arsenal.2: They've an armoury hidden in the very sky.
Did you hear that hum? My teeth are still ringing.
The air shivers around them like a struck bell.
That sound... it went right through my chest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.0: The shadows moved when they moved.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.1: It went dark around them, in broad day!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.darktide.2: Something in the dark answers to that one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.1: That band on their wrist just glowed green... no, it glowed wrong.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.power.xenoform.2: They were a person a moment ago. Weren't they?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.1: That thing has teeth everywhere! Get inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.symbiote.2: Guards! There's a living tar loose in the streets!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.0: A shadow walking on its own! Gods save us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.1: That's no man, that's a shade! Don't look at it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.shade.2: The dark's come for us! Inside, all of you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.0: A monster! A monster in the village!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.1: What in the world is THAT?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.2: Hide the children, something's come out of the sky!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.0: %s isn't themselves! Look at their eyes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.2: That's not %s any more. That black stuff has them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.0: The moon's bleeding. Bar the doors tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.1: Red moon. The dead don't stay down under a red moon.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.2: My grandmother said a moon like that means graves open.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.super_blood: Never seen it so red. Never. Pray.
The whole sky's the colour of a wound...
Get inside. Whatever comes up tonight, it's hungry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.0: Harvest moon! The fields'll be heavy come morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.1: Look how big and golden it is. A good omen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.2: Fine night for it. The crops love a moon like this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.0: A blue moon... they say anything can happen under one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.1: Strange light tonight. Strange things about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.2: The moon's gone cold and blue. I don't like it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.0: A rock fell out of the sky, %s blocks %s of here. Left a hole like a giant's fist.
